proof_explanation: The fix corrects the negate function to return Bool.not(value), implementing total Boolean negation. The law negate_matches_boolean_not requires negate(value) to equal Bool.not(value) for all Bool values. With the corrected implementation, negate(value) directly evaluates to Bool.not(value), making the equality a reflexive proof. The seeded attack (buggy source) is rejected because it violates this law by returning the input value unchanged rather than its negation.
